items.text: HOW TO NOT WASTE THE TRIP: go slowly and overlap. Blank walls confuse it, so keep trim, outlets, windows and door frames in shot. Curtains open. Polycam first in each room, then Scaniverse. Two passes, same walk.

The full diagnosis, log evidence and test results

THE VIDEO, one take, ~20 seconds. (1) Start on the cable plugged into the laptop. (2) Show the host recognising them: Displays pane or the terminal output. That half proves it is not the computer. (3) Turn the lenses to face your phone and press the dim button. A working pair leaks visible glow from the eyepieces; yours will not. (4) Say out loud: 'No on-device menu appears, which should display even with no source connected.' You are filming an ABSENCE, not a screen. Dark lenses on camera are the evidence.
Email happycustomer@viture.us. Order 113-4307365-6229868. Attach the video. Say: powers on, dim button responds, zero video output, no on-device menu with no source attached.
Include the three log lines: DP alt mode negotiated, HPD asserted, sinkCount 0. Says the fault is inside the glasses, not the host.
Say the tests are already done: HDMI via KIHENG, multiple hosts, both cable orientations. All black. Kills the "your computer does not support DP alt mode" reply.
Ask directly whether there is a display-side recovery flash or reset combo. The web updater only reaches the USB branch.
Expect a reply in 1-2 business days, and up to 7 days for the claim decision.
When they send an address: ORIGINAL PACKAGING and a TRACKABLE method, both required. You are in Canada until the 23rd, so ship from there rather than from Guatemala.

items.text: VOIP at 1080: dials out but does not ring on incoming. Check SIP ALG off on the Diallog router first, then shorten the registration/keepalive interval, then confirm the number is provisioned inbound.
Collect the Diallog REPLACEMENT router. ⚠️ If the old one is being swapped, re-check the VOIP: SIP ALG off on the NEW box before assuming the phone is still broken.

Call Diallog about the house phone not ringing. Ask them ONE thing directly: is the number provisioned for INBOUND, not just outbound? Tell them outgoing works and shows the right caller ID, so registration is fine. That skips twenty minutes of scripted troubleshooting.
Ethernet adapter for the Chromecast / streaming stick. Google made an official one; check it is still sold and order if so. For 1080, where wifi may be the weak link.
Look up moving the Plex library to the cloud. The Canada side cannot watch, and the Guatemala outage is exactly why: a home-hosted server dies with the house internet.

Home phone: move to the $5 ISP-independent plan and PORT the number. Diallog and you both spent hours and it never rang, including with the handset straight into the modem, so the router is ruled out.

VITURE warranty: what RETURN address is on the claim? You leave Canada Sunday. If they ship the repaired unit to where you are staying, it arrives after you have gone. Bernice at 925 9th Ave A East, N4K 6Y4, is the address that actually receives post.
